# VibeX — AI-Native Launch Platform
> Paste your AI project URL, get 5-7 concrete improvements from Claude in 30 seconds.

## What VibeX Does
VibeX reviews your AI project's launch page using Claude Sonnet 4.6. You paste a URL, Claude reads it like a first-time visitor, and returns structured, actionable feedback you can apply with one click. The gamification layer (evolution stages, pixel art, leaderboards) makes the feedback loop feel fun.

## Key Pages
- /launch — Forge a project (paste URL, get AI review)
- /home — Dashboard with projects and daily leaderboard
- /hunt — Realtime rankings powered by Supabase
- /ideas — AI-scored idea validation before you build
- /creators — Builder profiles ranked by shipped work
- /project/{id} — Individual project detail with review history

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack)
- Supabase (PostgreSQL, RLS, Realtime)
- Claude Sonnet 4.6 with tool_use for structured reviews
- React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + Framer Motion
- Bilingual UI (English / Chinese)

## API
REST API at /api/* — 43 endpoints for project management, agent execution, and webhooks.
